$comment: Snapshot of the closed broker-v2 panel operator vocabulary (phases, desired states, duty-outcome kinds, hold reasons, reconciliation verdicts, channel states, station ids, station states, action ids). Deploy starts a fresh identity; Stop is terminal. Two test surfaces lock against this file. Pytest PythonDataService/tests/broker/v2panel/test_vocabulary_snapshot.py reads the Python-tree copy and asserts equality with the live ALL_VOCABULARY_CODES frozenset and non-trivial copy for every code. The Frontend Vitest surface reads the Frontend-tree copy. Adding a code requires (a) updating vocabulary.py and (b) re-running PythonDataService/scripts/regenerate_broker_v2_vocabulary_snapshot.py. Either missing step fails a parity test.

BROKER_ACK.label: Broker ack
BROKER_ACK.explanation: The broker acknowledged (or rejected) the submitted order.

CRASHED.label: Crashed
CRASHED.explanation: The bot exited on an unhandled runtime error. This terminal outcome is not a market-data health verdict.

EXITED_UNVERIFIED.label: Exited unverified
EXITED_UNVERIFIED.explanation: The bot's task ended without a clean stop. Its final state is not confirmed.

FILL.label: Fill
FILL.explanation: The order executed, in full or in part, at the broker.

INTENT.label: Intent
INTENT.explanation: The bot recorded an order intent before touching the broker.

LIVE_ENVELOPE_LOSS_HOLD.label: Loss hold
LIVE_ENVELOPE_LOSS_HOLD.explanation: Today's loss reached the account's limit. New entries are refused account-wide until an operator clears the hold; exits still run.

NO_HOLD.label: No hold
NO_HOLD.explanation: No exposure hold is active. Order submission is allowed.

OFF_DUTY.label: Off duty
OFF_DUTY.explanation: The bot is not running. It evaluates no bars and places no orders.

ON_DUTY.label: On duty
ON_DUTY.explanation: The bot is running and evaluating bars as they close.

RECONCILED.label: Reconciled
RECONCILED.explanation: A sweep confirmed this account's records and the broker agree on this order.

RETIRED.label: Retired
RETIRED.explanation: The bot is permanently decommissioned. Its id is never reused.

RUNNING.label: Running
RUNNING.explanation: The operator wants this bot evaluating bars.

SIGNAL.label: Signal
SIGNAL.explanation: The bot evaluated a bar and produced (or withheld) a decision.

STOPPED.label: Stopped
STOPPED.explanation: The operator wants this bot idle. Exposure is left untouched.

STOPPED_OUTCOME.label: Stopped cleanly
STOPPED_OUTCOME.explanation: The bot exited on an operator stop or a service shutdown.

STREAM_HEALTH_HOLD.label: Stream-health hold
STREAM_HEALTH_HOLD.explanation: A market-data or execution channel is unhealthy. The account is on hold: new submits are refused until it recovers.

SUBMIT_GATE.label: Submit gate
SUBMIT_GATE.explanation: Holds and channel health were checked before submission.

UNEXPLAINED_ORDER_HOLD.label: Unexplained-order hold
UNEXPLAINED_ORDER_HOLD.explanation: An order this account did not submit was seen at Alpaca. The account is on hold: new submits are refused until it is reviewed.

UNKNOWN_HOLD.label: Hold active; cause unrecognised
UNKNOWN_HOLD.explanation: This account is on hold against new entries for a cause this version cannot name. New submits are refused account-wide until the hold clears.

archive.label: Clear
archive.explanation: Take a finished bot off Home. It must be stopped and flat, with nothing claimed. Its fills, fees and result stay in Activity. There is no undo.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.explanation: An identified condition is preventing this station from progressing.

cancel_order.label: Cancel order
cancel_order.explanation: Cancel one working order at the broker. The broker may reject the request if the order has already filled.

cancel_verified_working_orders.label: Cancel verified working orders
cancel_verified_working_orders.explanation: Cancel only working orders whose exact Clerk and broker identities are proven.

clean.label: Clean
clean.explanation: The last sweep found this account's records and the broker in agreement.

deploy.label: Deploy
deploy.explanation: Create and start a new bot bound to this account. The bot begins evaluating bars immediately after creation.

discharge_attributed_residue.label: Discharge stranded residue
discharge_attributed_residue.explanation: Write off an attributed position the broker does not hold. The Clerk re-reads the broker first and sends no order.

execute_safe_flatten.label: Execute safe flatten
execute_safe_flatten.explanation: Submit the prepared reduction as recovery EXIT custody with exact attributed quantities.

healthy.label: Healthy
healthy.explanation: The channel is connected and current.

missing_intent.label: Missing intent
missing_intent.explanation: The last sweep found broker inventory or an owned order that does not match the durable journal exposure.

not_applicable.label: Not applicable
not_applicable.explanation: This broker or mode has no such station.

open_custody_timeline.label: Open custody timeline
open_custody_timeline.explanation: Inspect the immutable operation-first evidence timeline.

prepare_safe_flatten.label: Prepare safe flatten
prepare_safe_flatten.explanation: Prepare a fresh reduction plan without submitting an order.

reconcile_now.label: Reconcile now
reconcile_now.explanation: Run a reconciliation sweep against the broker immediately. Useful after a hold is cleared or after a manual order intervention.

recover_exact_execution_evidence.label: Recover exact execution evidence
recover_exact_execution_evidence.explanation: Read one retained Alpaca paper execution and prepare the Clerk's no-delta coverage proof.

resolve_execution_coverage.label: Resolve execution coverage
resolve_execution_coverage.explanation: Replace one matching cumulative recovery record with verified exact execution evidence.

satisfied.label: Satisfied
satisfied.explanation: This station completed with recorded evidence.

stale.label: Stale
stale.explanation: The last sweep could not reach the broker; the verdict is out of date.

stop_bot_decisions.label: Stop bot decisions
stop_bot_decisions.explanation: Stop the bot making new decisions. Shares it holds are not sold.

unexplained_order.label: Unexplained order
unexplained_order.explanation: The last sweep found a broker order this account's records cannot explain.

unhealthy.label: Unhealthy
unhealthy.explanation: The channel is down or lagging. Trading is gated until it recovers.

unknown.label: Unknown
unknown.explanation: The channel's health has not been observed yet.

unknown_stale.label: Unknown (stale)
unknown_stale.explanation: Evidence for this station exists but is too old to trust.

waiting.label: Waiting
waiting.explanation: This station is expected to progress. Nothing is wrong.
